title: #041. Zebra Logic Grid Puzzle
subtitle: Model exact-one assignments and structured positional/relational clues with Z3 Boolean variables.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { satisfiable, assignment }.
judge.m1: When satisfiable is false, assignment must be null.
judge.m2: Puzzle is satisfiable, yet output returned satisfiable: false.
judge.m3: Clue {p0} is violated by the returned assignment.
judge.m4: Verified unsatisfiable: no assignment satisfies all clues.
judge.m6: assignment must be an array of length {p0}.
